query: Consider the following context: The ability to endure extreme corrosion in challenging environments is reduced in stainless steel. This can be addressed by appropriate surface modification techniques to redefine the surface with the required properties. In that context, which method can be used for improved corrosion resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: The application of a titanium dioxide (TiO2) coating on stainless steel using the sol-gel method can improve its corrosion resistance in extreme environments.
generation.material_initial_state: stainless steel exposed to extreme corrosion in challenging environments
generation.intervention: application of a TiO2 coating using the sol-gel method
generation.mechanism: the TiO2 coating acts as a barrier, preventing the penetration of corrosive species and reducing the reaction between the stainless steel and the environment
generation.predicted_outcome: a 30% reduction in corrosion rate compared to uncoated stainless steel
generation.uncertainty: the actual reduction in corrosion rate may vary depending on the specific conditions and the quality of the TiO2 coating

falsification_experiment.design: immersion test in a corrosive solution
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: if the corrosion rate of the TiO2-coated stainless steel is not at least 20% lower than that of the uncoated stainless steel, the hypothesis is falsified

system.state: exposed to extreme corrosion in challenging environments

frame.limitation: reduced ability to endure extreme corrosion
